item.title: Software Factory News - Thu 12 Nov 2026: Agents that built AWS Emulator, Harvey's harness, and CI built for agents
item.description:
Amazon's AWS Emulator built entirely by agents, Harvey's Spectre harness at 10,000 agent PRs, OpenAI's 1,000-hour Codex CI run, Robinhood's 60% no-review merges, CodeRabbit's 20x, making CI readable for agents, and two GitHub changes for Dependabot users.

Sources discussed:

  • How we built the agents that built AWS Emulator (Amazon, Matthew Goldberg)
  • The Agents Were Fine. Everything Around Them Broke. Joey Wang, Harvey (Sean Weldon write-up)
  • Codex fixed CI at OpenAI for 1,000 hours on a 200-word prompt (DEV Community)
  • An agent told to turn tests green can just delete the failing test (Adyog Pulse)
  • 60% of Our Data PRs Now Merge With No Human Review, Chetas Joshi, Robinhood (AI Engineer talk)
  • CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more (OpenAI)
  • What 1,000 CI Runs Taught Us About Making CI Work for Agents (Boris Barash)
  • Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories (GitHub Changelog)
  • Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Wed 11 Nov 2026: Toward the idea-to-deploy factory
item.description:
Oliver and Sophie walk through six stories (AWS Bedrock AgentCore remote Claude Code sessions, Cursor multiplayer Projects, Van Duc Nguyen's agent-fleet gates, Google's Agent Distraction study, GitHub Agentic Workflows GA, and CNCF on platform engineering) through the lens of a self-improving, idea-to-deploy software factory, then a deep dive on the autonomous CI/CD stack with examples from StrongDM, Vercel, Chipp and AWS ABCA.

Sources discussed:

  • Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls (AWS)
  • Cursor Projects is now multiplayer (Cursor)
  • Running a Coding Agent Fleet, Part 1: The Day the Agents Built Their Own Gates (Van Duc Nguyen)
  • Agent Distraction (Google Developers Blog)
  • GitHub Makes Agentic Workflows Generally Available with Isolation and Budget Controls (InfoQ)
  • Platform engineering needs to become more human…and less (CNCF)
  • StrongDM Software Factory
  • How StrongDM's AI team build serious software without even looking at the code (Simon Willison)
  • Built by Agents, Tested by Agents, Trusted by Whom? (Stanford CodeX)
  • Agent responsibly (Vercel)
  • The Autonomous Development Manifesto (Chipp)
  • ABCA: Autonomous Background Coding Agents on AWS (AWS Samples docs)
  • Enable self-healing systems with runtime controls (LaunchDarkly docs)
